'''Paul Terkovich''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Livingston tournament]] on 24 March 2001 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Flipping Endor Ops]], according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1961">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-26-livingston-nj-24-mar-01d1961/ livingston-nj-24-mar-01], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 26 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-26-livingston-nj-24-mar-01d1961/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
